title: Execute one selected complex child through its caller return
body:
Following PR2390's actual-child handoff, this executes selected rank-eight recipe 1522 (forward event 12553) through both nontrivial monomial adapters, its direct C^8 leaf, and the literal inverse inside a sequential caller parking/return wrapper. All 512 canonical operator columns bind the retained frame orientation and phase independently; a complete 3,072-record packet preserves dirty spectators, inactive caller packets and the opaque ancestor boundary.

The new result is the composed child boundary. PR2250's monomial and PR2287's coefficient primitives remain byte-for-byte pinned and credited. The package states the exact common-grid reserve and a conservative local payload-work bound, while metering payload movement and arithmetic separately. It covers f=1 only: Compact for f>1, recursive nonleaf children, complete private-centre execution, global tape/time admission, the outer transfer and kappa remain open.

Validation passed on Windows CPython 3.12.7: the registered optimized replay, all 262,144 operator entries, exact forward/inverse return, eight semantic rejection controls, isolated optimized relocation, and source/typed-receipt corruption rejection. A separate AI reviewer independently reran the primary verifier under CPython 3.12.14 with -I -O, reviewed the source/proof, and found no blocking issue. Parent proof review also found no blocker. No hosted CI, independent human review or formal-kernel proof is claimed.

Canonical main remains 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority revision 4. Picker seed 2c1b9914aca9ee2f875606d037a292c2 selected adversarial-audit; uniform-transfer-audit was refined to PR2390's implementation handoff after inspecting PR2327/2390 rather than repeating their precision ledgers. Final overlap covered 678 open PRs and 1,196 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; closest source heads were unchanged. Only research/selected-child-stream-return is added, including exact pins, proof, receipt, replay hooks, scope history and open next questions.
